o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish دَپَه (däpä), تَپَه (täpä), from Proto-Turkic *tepe.
From qol (“arm; hand”) + -ay. Compare Turkish kolay.
Borrowed from Arabic جَوْهَر (jawhar), from Classical Persian گوهر (gawhar). Doublet of gövhər.
Syllabic abbreviation of icraiyyə komitəsi, calque of Russian исполко́м (ispolkóm).
